title: Kestrel App Tool Reference: Past-Due Installment Payment
content:
A cure payment on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is the one-time scheduled-installment payment a borrower makes from their own bank account to bring the installments of a contract that are past their grace period up to date. It is applied to the interest accrued since the last payment date, then to the fees due, then to principal, and it moves the next due date one month later for each installment it brings current, never beyond the maturity date.

## Capability

`pay_past_due_installment_fb9b9167` pays a past-due installment of the borrower's own Kestrel Auto Finance loan from their bank account through the Kestrel app. The payment posts today as a scheduled-installment payment by online bank transfer for the installment named and is split exactly as entered between interest, fees and principal: the fees due fall by the fee part (recorded as fees paid), the principal balance falls by the principal part, the date interest last stopped accruing becomes today, and the next due date becomes the date entered.

## How it is invoked

This is the borrower's own tool. The representative unlocks `pay_past_due_installment_fb9b9167` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it in the Kestrel app.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_contract_id` | the reference number of the borrower's finance contract, as the representative reads it from the contract record | identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment this payment satisfies | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `next_due_date` | the contract's next due date with this payment in place | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `total_received` | the full payment | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places |
| `interest_portion` | the part applied to interest | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |
| `fee_portion` | the part applied to fees | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |
| `principal_portion` | the part applied to principal | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 when none |

## Return

When the payment posts: `status` "payment_posted", `finance_txn_id` (the payment entry's reference number), `total_received` (USD, 2 decimals), `principal_balance` (the principal remaining), `fees_due` (the fees remaining), `next_due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `last_payment_date` (today). The payment appears on the loan history as a scheduled-installment payment for the installment named.
